content.short: X Empire is a Telegram-born Web3 app built around the $X token, game-like growth loops, holder bonuses, and utility mini apps.
content.description: X Empire grew out of a Telegram mini-app audience and now centers on the $X token ecosystem. Its site describes $X exchange listings, on-chain holder bonuses based on wallet balances, and companion utility apps such as Feed, Langs, and Sleep. In this registry it fits as a TON-linked Telegram Web3 game and social app, not as a DEX or wallet. X EMPIRE X Empire - A system based on $X, uniting millions of people worldwide the links to the exchange are clickable. Users approach X Empire as a game first, while blockchain features support the surrounding economy, rewards, ownership, or community layer.
